impact.estimate: Estimate over the open periods of customers with the fiscal check switched on. Nothing is stored.

publish.warning: This change can affect the fiscal calculations of every customer and vehicle covered by this rule.

publish.noCurrent: There is no version in force yet: every parameter takes effect for the first time.

review.title: Review queue
review.description: Periods the application may not decide on its own: missing data or contradictions.

audit.description: Every change to rules, parameters, cases and data. Append-only; nothing can be changed or removed.

usage.title: Fiscal usage
usage.description: What the application derives from the reservation and what only people know. Confirmed answers decide the fiscal assessment.

usage.confirmedByPortal: Confirmed through the customer portal by {{name}} on {{date}}

vehicle.description: The facts the pseudo-eindheffing needs, each with its provenance. A manual value requires a reason and is recorded in the audit log.
vehicle.saved: Value saved; open periods are being reassessed.
vehicle.noAssessments: No assessments for this vehicle yet.

common.disclaimer: Calculated from the configured fiscal rules and the available data. This is not tax advice and not a return; when in doubt, manual review is required.

settings.title: Fiscal mobility check
settings.description: Pseudo-eindheffing on fossil passenger cars: one official configuration for all customers, versioned and audited. What a customer sees is set per customer in that customer’s portal settings.

overviewDialog.title: Fiscal check: overview
overviewDialog.hint: Latest assessment per open period. The configuration, the review queue and the audit log are in the app settings under Customer portal.
